Subject: Platform KPI deck + pre-QBR asks (latency spike follow-up)

Team — attaching the April KPI packet (platform_kpi_apr2027.pdf). High level: usage up 18% YOY, cost per 1k tokens down 3% from last month, uptime holding at 99.92% but we saw two 15–30s latency spikes on 3/28 that affected NebulaHealth during a heavy batch window.

As part of next week’s pre-QBR sync with Nebula, I need: 1) a one-paragraph root-cause summary for the latency spikes, 2) confirmation of mitigations (short/medium term), and 3) an owner for each action.

Proposed owners: Markus — root cause & mitigation plan; Jonas — customer-facing summary and pre-QBR script; Tessa — instrumentation and guardrails. Can each of you confirm? I’ve cc’d procurement at Nebula so they have the packet.

Thanks — let’s lock owners by EOD Monday.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Platform KPI deck + pre-QBR asks (latency spike follow-up)

Folks — dug into the telemetry and stitching notes (see latency_rootcause_notes.docx). Summary: two coincident factors on 2027-03-28 produced transient token amplification: 1) a customer-side burst of long-sequence batched requests (Nebula scheduled bulk scoring at 02:40 UTC) and 2) a simultaneous cloud host maintenance which temporarily reduced available preemptible slots, causing queue buildup and longer KV-cache warmups.

Short-term mitigations (owner / ETA):
- Rate-limited batch windows for large scoring jobs (Tessa / 48h): scheduling guard in the router to shift large batched jobs outside peak 02:00–04:00 UTC.
- Automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model when queue depth > X (Markus / 10d): reduces per-request latency at cost of slight quality delta.
- Increased KV-cache prewarm threshold for reserved pools (Vivek / 5d).

I attached the root cause notes and a small table that maps traffic traces to request IDs. I’ll push a short slide with the above to the shared drive.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Director, Platform Ops

Attachment: latency_rootcause_notes.docx (notes, 6 pages)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: procurement@nebulahealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform KPI deck + pre-QBR asks (latency spike follow-up)

Hi Allison / Nebula team — thank you for patience while we investigated. Attached is a mutual action plan draft (nebula_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx) with the mitigations Markus outlined plus proposed SLAs for scheduled large-batch scoring jobs.

Key commitments:
- Redwood to implement a scheduler safeguard to move bulk scoring out of the 02:00–04:00 UTC window (target deploy: 72 hours).
- Redwood to enable fallback to q4x quantized model when queue depth thresholds exceeded (target 10 days).
- Nebula agrees to notify Redwood 24–48 hours in advance for any large off-hour scoring runs while we complete automation.

Can you confirm these commitments (or propose edits) so we can finalize for the QBR readout?

Best,
Vanessa

Attachment: nebula_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
